name: Imperial Lords
description: The Imperial Lords were a youth street gang active in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York, primarily in the late 1950s and early 1960s. They operated in the area around the Marcy and Sumner Projects, near JHS 57, and maintained a close alliance with the Stompers and Medallion Lords. This three-gang bloc had a brother-club relationship with the Buccaneers until around 1960, when rising tensions over turf at PS 59 erupted into open warfare. By 1961, the conflict had produced multiple deaths on both sides.

sources.title: Marcy, Sumner and a Nest of Youth Gangs | New York City Fighting Gangs
